summary: Expose sparse organic terminal attachment evidence and observation coverage

schema.detail: No persisted schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: Terminal attachment and fresh-read latency rows with no qualifying recent observations explicitly say No qualifying events. With no retained qualifying events they remain no-data with no remaining-budget verdict, including under complete observation-time coverage. Retained eligible history still determines an existing verdict.

compatibility.detail: Native operational objective rows add nullable numeric coverage for their accounting horizon and explicitly describe unavailable coverage as unknown. Singular stream terminal remains the attachment key; plural stream terminals remains a listing and is excluded. Dedicated terminal stream first-screen instrumentation is not changed by this release.

manual.detail: No configuration changes required. Observation-time coverage is not a claim that all terminal viewers or attempts are instrumented.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback restores the previous objective presentation.
